# Broke But Functional

> A client-only personal finance simulator: make ₹10,000 last 30 days and preview the effect of any money decision on balance, daily allowance, savings goals, forecast, risk and financial health.

## Views

- Overview: balance, safe-to-spend amount, forecast chart, risk and health
- What if?: simulate a decision before applying it
- Activity: log income and expenses
- Plans: savings goals, subscriptions and commitments

## Notes

- No account, backend or API. Data is stored only in the visitor's browser.
